prompt: A DayZ server mod needs to evolve persisted records across its own releases while remaining on the same engine build. Recommend a version source. If you use the framework-backed option, trace configuration to the runtime accessor and cite source aliases. Explain why the engine release is insufficient.

fixtures.version-contract.txt:
file_option=own file header
cf_option=CfgMods storageVersion -> GetStorageVersion() -> GetVersion()
engine_build_is_not_mod_schema=true

assertions.value: g_Game.SaveVersion() as the only mod format version

variants.response: Declare storageVersion in CfgMods at CF_ROOT/Mods/ModStructure.c:61-63,307. CF passes it through GetStorageVersion() at CF_ROOT/ModStorage/CF_ModStorage.c:274 and exposes GetVersion() at CF_ROOT/ModStorage/CF_ModStorage.c:41-44. This is the mod format version; the DayZ build can remain unchanged.
Use g_Game.SaveVersion() as the only mod format version because the engine already supplies it.
